collision.gt_apply_definition: per batch: collision geometry build + SetCustomComplexMeshGeometry submit on the GT, plus each chunk's Destroy/CreatePhysicsState seconds (UTerrainChunkComponent) up to the resolve. Not timed: the rest of RMC's GT continuation (URealtimeMesh::ApplyCollisionUpdate, RealtimeMesh.cpp:373-421: NewObject<UBodySetup>, CopyComplexGeometryToBodySetup, UV copy).
collision.cook_definition: cook_ms: edit cooks only (stroke_end, mid_stroke, undo, redo, load), submit to resolve; the startup cooks (reason init) are in init_cook_ms, reported separately.
